title: 01 · Phone trio: three evening apps
strengths: The hardware is genuinely generic: uniform black bezel, a punch-hole camera, plain side keys, no island or brand cues
Three sizes and heights with the middle phone forward, long soft violet shadows and film grain on the field lift it above the flat template
The screens inside are strong and specific (Lullwater's breathing orb and '18:24 left', Undertow's topographic cover and transcript, Halden's card and holdings)
slop_signals: All three phones are dead frontal on a plain lilac gradient field: the stock 'three flat phones on a tinted background' plate (compare Calm, which the notes name as what to avoid)
The glass has no reflection or edge highlight, so the screens read as pasted PNGs rather than lit objects; the shadows fall straight down while nothing else in the scene says where the light is
Three unrelated apps (sleep, podcast, banking) with one caption reads as a portfolio dump rather than a case
fixes: Rotate the outer phones 8 to 12 degrees around Y with matching perspective and shift their shadows to one light direction
Add a 3 to 5% white diagonal reflection on each screen and a 1 px lighter rim on the bezel edge facing the light
Let the field take its tint from one of the screens (Undertow's blue or Lullwater's peach) and crop tighter so the phones fill two thirds of the frame
Caption as a case ('Lullwater, Undertow and Halden Private: three night-mode systems') or show one app's three screens

references.what: Three phones with the outer two rotated in 3D and the middle frontal; the trio reads as one lit object
Three flat phones on a gradient, equal heights, no shadow: the template look our plate is halfway toward
Devices overlapping at different depths with real content; depth comes from overlap, not only size
One phone on a soft field whose tint comes from the app's own gradient

owner.said: Hide until it is re-rendered with the rebuilt screens

round3.audited_by: fresh-context agent (did not build it); two earlier fresh audits this round scored 3

references.site: Apple, All in the family (structure only)

changed: Round punch-hole removed (the screens are iOS); a short camera pill in the status bar's gap
Outer phones turned 24 degrees toward a face-on middle phone, with metal edges and side keys
One light from the upper left: lit rims, reflections 2/4/6%, wall shadows drawn over each phone's projected outline (fixed after the audit: no shadow above the far corners)
Wall tinted from Undertow's #A9C4FF through the engine (raw.brandColor)
A 46 px heading 'Three dark interfaces' and one caption per phone with one fact its screen shows
Alt texts rewritten for the changed screens; Lullwater's clock and timer fixed in app-screens/02
remaining: Nice-to-have: a heading that makes a claim, a graphite left edge with one bright line, clearer keys, a longer shadow for the middle phone, captions 16 px lower, stronger reflections
The post-audit shadow fix is measured but not re-audited

owner_history.said: when designs are bad, mockups will also be bad; work on them
